basic_details.short_information: DIAT Recruitment 2026 is for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering of the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Girinagar, Pune. The post is under a MoES-sponsored research project and is purely temporary for 10 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The stipend is ₹37,000/- + HRA (as applicable) per month. You need B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in CSE/IT/ECE or a related domain in First Division with NET/GATE, or M.E./M.Tech. in the same fields with First Division at both graduate and postgraduate level. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice says the department is looking for "young Scientists/Engineers" for the JRF position. The essential qualification is either of the following: B.E./ B.Tech/ M.Sc. in CSE/IT/ECE or related domain in First Division with NET/GATE OR M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/IT/ECE or related domain with First Division both at Graduate & Post Graduate level The qualification or experience must have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions/Industries. The upper age limit is "not to exceed 28 years". The crucial date for working out the upper age limit is 6 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Stipend: ₹37,000/- + HRA (as applicable) per month. Medical: On top of the monthly stipend, you get medical facilities limited to MI Room facilities. Tenure: The position is purely temporary for 10 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. No absorption: A JRF offer does not give any right to absorption in DIAT, Pune. Ph.D.: Recruited Fellows will be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. at DIAT through proper channels, as per DIAT norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIAT Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator. The notice says the documents may be sent this way, as one PDF file: Get the application form. The notice says it is available on the website. Put together a brief bio-data, duly signed, along with the filled application form. Add proof of date of birth, and the BE./B.Tech and M.E/M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates. Combine everything into a single PDF file. Email it to [email protected] with the subject "Application for JRF", on or before 6 November 2026. The Screening Committee may consider qualifications and experience above the minimum. Because of this, the notice tells candidates to list all of them clearly in the application, with supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through shortlisting and then an interview. Shortlisting: Applicants are called for the interview based on how well they suit the project. The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and having them does not guarantee a place at every stage. If there are many applications, the Principal Investigator may limit the number called for interview, based on the Screening Committee's recommendations. This would take into account qualifications and experience above the minimum prescribed. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates will be told individually by email. Interview mode: The interview will be "in-person" or "via video conferencing", whichever suits DIAT. Shortlisted candidates will be told which. What to bring: The original application with all necessary educational and other supporting documents, project reports, publications etc., plus 1 (one) set of self-attested copies of each. TA/DA: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate must join duty immediately on receiving the offer letter. For details or clarification, contact Dr. Upasna Singh, PI, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, or Prof. Odelu Ojjela, Co-PI. Telephone: (020) 2460 4533 /37/3/39. Mobile: +91 9420213114/ 7798868907.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DIAT Recruitment 2026 for JRF?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under Advt. No. 31-2026/JRF/DIAT, in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, DIAT, Pune.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DIAT JRF post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DIAT JRF post?
faq.answer: You need B.E./ B.Tech/ M.Sc. in CSE/IT/ECE or a related domain in First Division with NET/GATE. The alternative is M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/IT/ECE or a related domain with First Division at both graduate and postgraduate level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DIAT JRF post?
faq.answer: Your age must not exceed 28 years as on 6 November 2026. SC/ST, Women and PwBD candidates get up to 05 years of relaxation, and OBC (NCL) candidates get up to 03 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for DIAT JRF?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is ₹37,000/- + HRA (as applicable) per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any other benefit paid on top of the DIAT JRF stipend?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA (as applicable) is paid on top of the ₹37,000/- monthly stipend. Medical facilities limited to MI Room facilities are also provided.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the DIAT JRF post?
faq.answer: Email a signed brief bio-data, the application form, proof of date of birth, and your BE./B.Tech and M.E/M.Tech mark sheets and degree certificates to [email protected]. Send them as one PDF file by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject of the email should be "Application for JRF".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DIAT JRF?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted based on how well they suit the project, and the shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. The interview will be in person or by video conference, whichever suits DIAT, and shortlisted candidates are told by email.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DIAT JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for 10 months or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. The JRF offer gives no right to absorption in DIAT, Pune.
